name: Hints of a New Plague?
summary: Kinelory is bound for Go'Shek Farm, where Apothecary Jorell's deadly experiments continue. Quae has learned of them from a folder, but she is too hurt from a clash with orcs to go along.

sections.title: Jorell's Experiments
sections.body: The folder shows that Jorell is conducting deadly experiments at Go'Shek Farm. Quae does not know what they mean for Hillsbrad. But Phin would not want them to continue. Some of Jorell's research has already reached Tarren Mill.

sections.title: Kinelory's Protector
sections.body: Quae fought some orcs while you were away, and now she cannot help Kinelory. Kinelory plans to go to the farm and take the research Jorell has not yet sent to Tarren Mill. She needs your protection on the way.

sections.title: Kinelory's Resolve
sections.body: Kinelory says she will destroy every one of the Forsaken herself if that brings Phin peace. Since the plague, Phin has done so much for Kinelory and the others. They had never thought they would find friends or family again. Kinelory asks you to tell her when you are ready, and then you will set out together at once.

faq.answer: Quae fought some orcs while you were away and is in no shape to help Kinelory.

faq.q: What was discovered in the folder?
faq.answer: The folder reveals Apothecary Jorell's deadly experiments at Go'Shek Farm.

faq.q: Why are Quae and Kinelory investigating this?
aliases: why do they care about the plague
faq.answer: Quae and Kinelory are Phin's companions. Phin leads a band of adventurers investigating odd happenings, and he would not want Jorell's experiments to continue.

faq.q: Where is the research being sent?
faq.answer: Some of Jorell's research has already gone to Tarren Mill. Kinelory plans to take what he has not yet sent.
